part: Operations page composition — OperationsLedger (real page component, not the ListSurfaceShell primitive or the bare RegionDimensionMatrix)
source: dc.html p8 (#p8): masthead (VOL line, ANTON title, 'N active items · M jurisdictions · six dimensions per region · every fact carries a source and date' scope line, scoped search placeholder, Ask), the four band tiles, the 'REGIONS SIDE BY SIDE' matrix CARD (ruling 5.1 top rule, Anton head + coverage meta, table, foot strip with 'Compare against:' and the dash convention), band cards each closed by a foot strip ('All N <band>' and the transition into the next band), and the rail in order FILTERS (REGION then DIMENSION) → COVERAGE GAPS → LEGEND.
notes: This spec measures the COMPOSED page, region by region, in document order — the operator's own complaint was placement, not part styling ('the filters were not above the regulations, they were on the right ... you are NOT matching the images directly'). operations-matrix.json still measures RegionDimensionMatrix alone (six D1-D6 rows, ruling 3.3); this one measures where that matrix SITS and what surrounds it.

Fixture (mounts.mjs 'compose-08-operations') is invented sample data with the real prop shapes: 25 rows split 0/4/2/19 across the bands, 5 regions, populated region_dimension_coverage + regional_data_facts rows. The audit asserts geometry, placement and the components' own literals, never fixture values.

The runner reads computed STYLE and textContent only: an `expect` key naming an HTML attribute (e.g. an input's placeholder) measures as null and reports a false MATCH, so no such key appears here. The page-scoped command-bar prompt artboard 08 states is verified in the side-by-side evidence PNG (docs/design/handoff-2026-09-06/built/compose-08-operations-list.png), not by this spec.

Placement assertions use sibling-combinator selectors, which match only when the first element's DOM node PRECEDES the second's — 'present but in the wrong place' was the defect, so absence-only checks would not have caught it.

R7 (an app feature the artboard does not draw is kept, listed, and moved out of an artboard region's position): the US By-state cost sub-list moved from between the matrix and the first band card to the disclosure position at the foot of the content column; the Mode facet stays but sits after the artboard's own REGION and DIMENSION groups. Both are checked below.

children.name: matrix card carries ruling 5.1's graduated top rule (it was a bare section with a 15px h2)
matrix card head title is the Anton section title, 20px uppercase
matrix card foot strip exists and states the dash convention (artboard p8 foot: the 'Compare against' control plus the no-data note)
the 'Compare against' control sits in the card FOOT, not above the table (it moved; DOM order is the check)
the matrix card precedes the first band card's foot strip — the matrix is FIRST in the content column, above the band cards
every band card is closed by a foot strip carrying the transition into the next band (or 'end of list' on the last)
the last band card's foot strip says 'end of list'
rail FILTERS card mounts before the COVERAGE GAPS card (p8 rail order: Filters, Coverage gaps, Legend)
rail COVERAGE GAPS card mounts before the LEGEND card
rail facet order is REGION then DIMENSION (p8's own two groups, in p8's order)
the R7 extra (Mode, which p8's rail does not draw) follows both artboard groups, never ahead of one
FILTERS card carries the DIMENSION group (p8 rail: D1 Regulatory feasibility ... D6 Operational cost)
all six dimensions D1-D6 render in the rail with no '+ N more' disclosure hiding D6
COVERAGE GAPS card carries counted gap rows, not prose alone
masthead scope line carries p8's own standing sentence after the live counts
children.textMatch: six dimensions per region · every fact carries a source and date
children.note: p8: 'N active items · M jurisdictions · six dimensions per region · every fact carries a source and date'. The two counts are live fields, so only the standing half is matched as text.

forbid.name: no content-column facet chip strip above the rows
forbid.reason: Operator audit: 'the filters were not above the regulations, they were on the right — same on every page.' Operations' facets live in the rail's FILTERS card only.

forbid.name: no per-page ask panel on the list surface
forbid.reason: The Masthead's CommandBar is the only search/ask surface; artboard 08 has no second ask bar and no floating Ask control (operator rulings 2.2/2.3).

forbid.name: the literal word UNSCORED as page text
forbid.reason: Operator ruling P1 2.1: the literal token never appears. Absence renders the lowercase fixed-vocabulary word with uppercase CSS, so textContent reads lowercase.

forbid.name: no 'Facts' label in the expanded dimension row's leading cell
forbid.reason: Artboard 08/id="p8" leaves that cell EMPTY: the dimension is already named by the '▾ Labor markets' row directly above it. The cell itself stays, so the facts columns keep the header row's alignment.

forbid.name: no trailing 'N regional operations profiles across N regions' line below the band cards
forbid.reason: Artboard 08/id="p8" draws nothing below the band cards; the item total and the jurisdiction count are already in the masthead scope line. Same shared slot cleared on /regulations and /market.

forbid.name: D-M4: no list row carries more than one absence token
forbid.reason: D-M4 (operator mobile report 2026-09-08) [CONFIRMED at 1440 and at 390]. The impact, due and tier cells each rendered their own <Absence>, so a row missing all three drew a dashed baseline plus UNSCORED plus PENDING plus NOT IN PRIMARY SOURCE — three tokens, the third on a line of its own. Ruling 2.1 allows exactly ONE reason per row. This selector matches a row carrying a token in TWO of the three cells, which is the defect and nothing else. The structural guarantee is ListRow's `reasonSlot`.
